                          MESSAGE FROM THE PRINCIPAL (I/C)
                                MR. RANJIT SARMA
         Education is the backbone of a healthy, progressive and prosperous human society. Every educational
institution plays a pivotal role in disseminating knowledge and inculcating values among individuals. An
educational institution needs to enrich the store-house of knowledge and distribute the nectar of education
among the students. In the process it contributes towards the building of responsible citizen of the nation. With
the unprecedented development in Information and Communication Technology, the quality of imparting
education should be adopted accordingly to meet the demands of global competitive environment.
         A society’s march towards prosperity will only remain a dream, its aspirations unfulfilled and
unrealized, till the students’ community is lagging behind morally and intellectually. Hence, in order to keep
pace with time, the students ought to be oriented with the latest developments in all spheres of life and be
acquainted with the latest technologies. But to orient the students with latest developments is a challenging
task. Mangaldai Commerce College is resolved to face all adversities posed by circumstances, both physical
and social. The college is striving it’s best to uplift the students and invigorate them to meet the challenges
through quality education. As a reward of the college fraternity’s constant endeavour and their sincere efforts,
many students have been able to glorify the name of the college with their best performances in education,
sports and other fields of excellence.
         With a view to materializing the dreams of imparting quality education, our college has undertaken a
number of innovative schemes. In the fast-changing social scenario, the education system needs constant
assessment and up-gradation for which our college fraternity has been working relentlessly. As the Principal
of this college, I hereby take pledge to devote my time and spirit for all round development of the college.
With this aim we, the entire staff of Mangaldai Commerce College, are providing various facilities to the
students and the college authority has directed its endeavours towards constructing a good college campus at
the earliest. Academic and intellectual events like seminar, workshop, field study, study tour constitute some
of the routine academic events taken up in the college.

     ABOUT INTERNAL QUALITY ASSURANCE CELL (IQAC)

As per the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) guidelines
every accredited institution should establish its own Internal Quality Assurance
Cell (IQAC). This is essential to maintain the post-accreditation quality of the
College. Quality enhancement being a continuous process, the IQAC becomes a
part of the institution’s system and works towards realization of the goals of quality
enhancement and sustenance.
In 31st December, 2021 as a part of NAAC quality sustenance effort the Internal
Quality Assurance Cell was established in Mangaldai Commerce College. The
establishment of IQAC has marked a watershed as far as the understanding of the
notion of “Quality Assurance” in the College is concerned. The IQAC at                      Dr. Dhiren Deka
Mangaldai Commerce College is successful not only in taking up several quality             IQAC, Coordinator
assurance activities but also in the creation of an institutional database in the College.
One of the significant contributions of IQAC is to implement the student’s feedback on the curriculum. The
feedback is collected online and is done at the end of each semester. The feedback collected on curriculum is
compiled and are reported to the departments. The departments, in turn, take up necessary corrective measures.
Mangaldai Commerce College was accredited by NAAC in 2023 for the first cycle of accreditation. The IQAC
of Mangaldai Commerce College continued to strive for the betterment of processes and setup.

ROUTINE ACTIVITIES OF IQAC
      Preparation of the Annual Report for forwarding it to Ministry of Human Resource Development,
       Govt. of India
      Preparing of the Annual Quality Assessment Report and submitting it to NAAC, Bangalore
      Participating in National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) and sending necessary after
       compiling those collected from the departments and sections.
      Presenting before all stakeholders of the university the area where the university needs improvement
       following the release of NIRF ranking every year.
      Collection of annual Performance Based Appraisal (PBAS) of faculties and Feedback on
       Curriculum from students


BEYOND NORMAL ACTIVITIES OF IQAC
      Preparation of subject wise List of Journals for forwarding to UGC
      Preparing the application formats for Direct Recruitments (Teaching Positions), Career
       Advancement Schemes and Performance-Based Appraisal as per latest UGC guidelines
      Performing data entry and analysis of Green Audit
      Devising the Consultancy Rules for the university
      Conducting of Training Programs for the Administrative Officers
      Provide guidelines to College Administration based on the suggestions of the Peer Team during the
       previous NAAC visit.
      IQAC conducted the much-awaited Students Satisfaction Survey in 2023 and forwarding necessary
       suggestions to the College Administration for providing student-related amenities or services.
      Procuring of API Calculator- online software for calculation of academic performance score for
       teachers. Now the teachers have to input their performance-related activities and the API score is
       automatically calculated.
      Feedback of Students on curriculum is made online and the entire activity goes paperless.

  PROFILE OF THE COLLEGE:
       Mangaldai Commerce College, a premier institution of Commerce in the state and the only
Commerce College in the Darrang district, was established by some dedicated and noted educationist, in the
year 1982. It was possible only due to the aspiration of the people of Darrang, their help and cooperation
under the relentless and untiring efforts of a hand of dedicated workers.
The college sprawling scenic ad serene campus spreads over a vast area on the north fringe of the town, at a
distance of nearly 1.5 km from the ASTC Bus Stand and easily accessible from the town. Situated in a natural
setting the river Mangaldai on the western side, the campus houses several buildings catering to the academic
needs and support facilities.

        The need of Commerce College was actually felt keeping in mind the fact that a large number of
students preferring for commerce education had to go to the commerce colleges which are far away from their
places. The Darrang district including the surrounding areas of Assam are industrially fast developing day by
day. As such, the need of the hour was a job oriented educational institution. Keeping in view this aspect, with
the unlimited efforts of some dedicated people of the college has come to the present position. Meanwhile, the
several batches of students had passed out from this college both in Higher Secondary and Degree levels with
flying colors since its inception. In the Higher Secondary level besides compulsory subjects’ optional subjects
like Economics, Banking, Commercial Mathematics and Statistics, Insurance being offered to the students
according to their aptitude. In the Degree course, the college is offering major in Accountancy, Management
and Banking besides other compulsory and optional subjects of the commerce stream. The teaching imparted
by a team of dedicated teachers who are totally devoted to their duties and responsibilities having all of them
a background of brilliant academic career and distinction.


 VISION OF THE COLLEGE
“To be an institute of academic excellence with total commitment to quality education in Commerce,
management and related fields.”

 MISSION OF THE COLLEGE

 *    Empowering students with all the knowledge and guidance that they need to fit in the global business
      world.
 *    Learning by doing
 *    Providing for holistic and value-based development of students, which ultimately enhances their
      employability.
 *    To carve a niche for ourselves in the specialized field of commerce and management.
 *    Grooming youth to become a truly global personality well equipped to deal with the modern world and
      its challenges.

 GOALS AND OBJECTIVES OF THE COLLEGE

  *   To spread Commerce Education in this region, i.e., the North East of India.
  *   To achieve academic excellence.
  *   To strive for better results.
  *   To offer the best infrastructure facilities to students, teachers, employees.
  *   To offer specialized courses in commerce.
  *   To plan full employment for its alumni through service and entrepreneurship.
                                                                                                          pg. 7
                                                PROSPECTUS 2025-26
   *    To mould students into ideal citizens with commendable human values.


 MOTTO OF THE COLLEGE
       Dissemination of information and knowledge as a centre of excellence in higher education by
imparting quality education and pursuing research studies.


 SIGNIFICANCE OF THE COLLEGE EMBLEM
       The emblem of college contains a wealth of meaning. On it is inscribed the
name of the college and its motto in three Sanskrit words- “BANIJYE BASATI
LAKHIMI” which means “Wealth through trade” Le. “Wealth”. The verbal
from of “Lakhimi” indicates that the businessman is the rightful person of the fruits
of business and one can get wealth through trade or business where Commerce
education can inspire.



      OTHER FACILITIES AVAILABLE:

    COLLEGE LIBRARY AND READING ROOM
       The Mangaldai Commerce College Library is located in the ground floor of separate block which is
newly constructed. It is the centre of attraction for both the students and the teachers. The library operates
under guidance of a library committee that meets regularly and reviews the library functions. Mangaldai
Commerce College Library is a modern computerised library with KOHA software through which all the
house-keeping operation like acquisition cataloguing, circulation, serial control and Online Public Access
Catalogue (OPAC) were done. We preserved college publication, Books, Magazine, Question Papers, College
Prospectus, Ph.D. Thesis, M. Phil dissertations of teachers in our digital library software (D-SPACE). Through
N-LIST consortia and NDLI platform, we provide access facilities of e-resources to the teachers and students
of our college. The library of our college has been performing various activities from time to time, such as
mobile library services, library visit, library books exhibition and reading facilities for the children of under
privilege people, book donation to different institutions, observed the National Librarian Day etc. for the
benefit of the students, weaker sections and community at large.
       Students may borrow books from the library against their Library Cards and also avail the e-resources
of the library. They may read various newspapers and journals in the Reading Room of the library. There is a
book bank facility meant for the poor and needy students.

    GRIEVANCES REDRESSAL CELL
       The College has a Grievances Redressal Cell in place. The cell is created to redress grievances of
stakeholders relating to college affairs. Grievances are received through drop boxes, one of which is placed
infront of the college library and the other infront of the Office of the Principal. A student by mentioning
his/her name, admission receipt number, section and class roll number shall record his/her grievances in a A4
size paper and drop it in any of the drop boxes. Any other stakeholder will record his/her name, address and
contact number along with grievances, if any, and drop the same in any of the boxes. The Committee formed
for the purpose will look into such grievances and do the needful to redress the grievances.
   CANTEEN
             The college canteen provides refreshments for the staff and students at a reasonable rate in a
      hygienic environment.
   PARKING
               There is one parking shed for vehicles in the northern part of the college.

               Purified drinking water is available for all in the college.
   FEED BACK BOX

       college office.
   COLLEGE PLAY GROUND
               A play ground is in the process of development in the eastern part of the college.
   SMART CLASS ROOM
             The college has a well -Air-Conditioned Smart Class Room for Conducting Seminars,
       Workshops, Counselling Sessions, Campus Recruitment Process, Teachers Parent Meet etc.

   BOYS' COMMON ROOM
               The college has 01 Boys' Common Room well-equipped with Carom Boards and Chess Boards
       for playing during leisure period.

   GIRLS' COMMON ROOM
              The college has well-furnished Girls' Common Room well equipped with Carom Boards and
       Chess Boards for playing during leisure period. It too facilitates the provision of sanitary pad vending
       machine for the convenience of the girls.

   VILLAGE ADOPTION BY THE COLLEGE
           Gadhiapara Revenue Village at Darrang has been adopted by the Mangaldai Commerce
    College.

 INTAKE CAPACITY: 300
     * Duration: 2 years
     * Eligibility:
        To apply for admission in to the 1st Year class of Higher Secondary course of commerce, a student has
to pass –
        *   H.S.L.C. Examination under Board of Secondary Education, Assam. Or
        *   Any other equivalent examination recognized by Assam Higher Secondary Education Council.

 ADMISSION PROCEDURE
        Details about the admission procedure is available in the College website.
       A. Admission into college is made STRICTLY IN ORDER OF MERIT AND IS GOVERNED BY
          ADMISSION RULES. Decision of the Admission Committee regarding admissions is final.
       B. B. All admissions are strictly on merit subject to the reservation for caste quota (SC / ST (P) / ST
          (H) / OBC / MOBC) as per the standing rules of the Government of Assam. Photocopy of the caste
          certificate must be attached along with the online application form for admission. Any application
          form without valid caste certificate will be considered under general category.
       C. A maximum 5% of the seats are earmarked as per break up given below for outstanding Sports
          Persons/ NCC Cadets/ Scouts & Guides/ proficiency in cultural activities/ wards of the employees
          of the college etc.
          i)      2% for Sports persons of sports recognised by IOA/ SAI and also for the candidates who
                  have represented District/ State etc.

    ii)       1% for wards of employees of the college.
   iii)      1% for NCC/ Scouts/ Guides.
   iv)       1% for the students with achievements in cultural activities.

D. No claim for caste benefit will be entertained if copy of the original caste certificate issued by the
   appropriate authority and countersigned by the DC/ADC/SDO/SDC concerned is not uploaded
   along with the Online Application Form.
E. ANY PRESSURE AND INTERFERENCE FROM ANY QUARTER FOR ADMISSION OF A
   PARTICULAR STUDENT WILL RESULT IN FORFEITURE OF HIS /HER APPLICATION
   FOR ADMISSION.
F. For the purpose of confirmation of admission in H.S. 1st Year (Com) course, candidates are
   required to produce the following in original for physical verification within 10 days from
   the date of commencement of classes:
    * Recent digital coloured passport size photograph.
    * Mark sheet of last examination passed.
    * Migration Certificate in case of CBSE and Other Board’s students.
    * Caste certificates from competent authority wherever necessary.
    * Students passing the qualifying examination earlier than the current year will have to submit
        a Court Affidavit (Candidates having a gap period of more than 3 years are not eligible for
        admission as per the guidelines issued by AHSEC).
    * For students admitted under especially abled category: Minimum 40% disability certificate.
G. Admissions are provisional and subject to the approval of AHSEC.
H. Admission into H.S. Second year will take place immediately after their H. S. 1st year Annual
   Examination Results are declared.
I. CANCELLATION OF ADMISSION:
       Admission of a candidate will be cancelled if any false information/misrepresentation in the
   online Form is detected subsequently, or if a candidate fails to produce all the required documents,
   in original, for physical verification.

GENERAL RULES & REGULATIONS
    All the students are responsible to the college Principal and all teachers for their general conduct both
        inside and outside the college.

        will require prior permission from the Principal/ Convenor, Students Welfare Committee/ Director
        of the Association.

        meeting without the Principal’s prior permission.
    No student will collect any money within or outside the college campus, using the college name in any
        form as contribution for extra or co-curricular activities or for charity, without the prior permission
        of the Principal. In case the permission is granted, a complete account of the money so collected
        should be prepared and submitted within a period of 15 days from the completion of the event.
    A student registered in a Semester, for any course (degree or H.S.), shall be required to have a minimum
        cumulative attendance of 75% of the total lectures prescribed for the course during that
        Semester/term/year. Although the attendance shall be cumulative for all the papers/courses taken
        together, in the given Semester/Term/Year, a student shall be required to have a minimum of SO%
        attendance in any individual paper I course.

        all.

        are allowed.

        college, the Principal can ask such a student to leave the college without assigning further reasons.

        authorities. Visitors will particularly not be permitted to meet students while a lecture/practical
        session is in progress except under exigencies, with prior permission of the Principal.

        dues (breakage, damage, loss etc.) and return library books by the end of the academic year.
    The Principal’s decision in all matters of the college will be final and binding on all the students.
